connector.name: MCP Server Cloud Fs
connector.registryDescription: Cloud replacement for mcp-server-filesystem - 20 tools for S3, Azure Blob, and GCS
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-cloud-fs. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nogoo9 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: Azure Blob Storage connection string (required when using the azure provider)

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: Google Cloud project ID (optional when using the gcs provider)

env.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: AWS Access Key ID (optional for S3 — falls back to ~/.aws/credentials or IAM role)

env.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: AWS Secret Access Key (optional for S3 — falls back to ~/.aws/credentials or IAM role)

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.description: Redis connection URL (required when --cache-store redis, defaults to redis://localhost:6379)
